# Akari InvestAI — machine-readable storefront

> Measured crypto/x402 data for agents. Free tier is real data, not a teaser.
> Pay with x402 on Base (USDC). Every paid route answers 402 first.

## Free, no payment
- PAY/CAUTION/AVOID + 0-100 score + evidence_count: /x402/wallet-verdict/preview?address=0x…  [paid upgrade 0.25 /x402/wallet-verdict?address=0x…]
- 3 rows from the HL round-trip tape and 3 settled in-play tickets, plus columns: /x402/dataset/preview
- graded x402 seller ledger (791 sellers, our method, no charge): https://edvyno.github.io/akari-proof/scoreboard.json
- any single seller's page, free: /seller?host=<host>  (badge: /seller/badge.svg?host=<host>)

- Akari Wallet Balance & Payer Vetting — USDC and ETH balances for any EVM wallet on Base, transaction count, x402 payer intelligence — $0.02 — call origin + /x402/wallet-intel
